items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2026-20896
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2026-20896 surged from 32% to 62% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2026-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. Gitea Docker image versions up to and including 1.26.2 use REVERSE_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES=* by default, allowing any source IP to impersonate a user when reverse-proxy authentication headers such as X-WEBAUTH-USER are enabled.
